Y-you blockhead!

#C236196003S-Saber#CDEF…!?

You focus on commanding in your battles.
Oh please, knowing you, it will be fi… ne…

For now, there are no immune programs

#C236196003A-Archer#CDEF…!?

Now, give in and whisper of love for #C236196003Tamamo#CDEF!
Then, you can slowly disrobe and inspect
the texture of the walls! It's A-OK!
Anyway, let's press on.

Wahh! Wait, WAIT!
It's dangerous to walk around alone!
And please don't ignore meeeee!

There's no one there.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF of course won't be here, but I don't see the
familiar #C236196003Rin#CDEF said she would send with me…!
W-what do I do…!?

I-it's okay, you're okay there!
I think you're outside the immune
programs' patrol route.

It's #C236196003Rin#CDEF―there may be some lag time
before materializing the familiar.
Help is on the way.
#C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF…!?
Why can I hear #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF's voice!?

My body may be frozen, but I'm always
discerning. Although, all I can do is
look about.
W-what do I do…!?

M-my ears, my EARS are SPLITTING…!
T-this toxic, ultraviolet voice―
Don't tell me…!
A familiar voice echoes from the cube…
I say―

I'm sure, I'm sure!
It's just as #C236196003Rin#CDEF said. Goodness,
you'll never make it without me, #[piggy][squirrely]#!

Don't you long for a cute, dependable, strong,
and also cute idol Servant?
A familiar voice echoes from the cube once more…
I say―
Please, spare me.
Seriously, please spare me.
The cube's rotation reaches its peak.
She points right at me, and I unconsciously clap.
What's your angle, anyway!?
Yeah. That's right.
How did she break the seal, and why is she lending me a hand?

…I can't believe it.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is going to fight as a
Servant for #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF?
But…
But we can't do that.

And I'm not getting time served.
I've got a life sentence, anyway.

Give thanks.
Go forth and fulfill your new desire.

…I was not expecting to see a time where
I would pair up with #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF…

D-don't move so wildly!
I-it's embarrassing for me!
No running or striking cool poses!
Be reasonable, #C236196003Saber#CDEF.

If all you eat is greasy food,
you'll start having a messy style.
エミヤの反応（仮）
No, Darling, you mustn't go there鷙

Are you stupid?
Well, you always totally were.

Everyone knows that flab is ugly no
matter where it is.
Not "as if"―you actually DO have scales!
ギルガメッシュの反応（仮）

Thinking about it now,
pairing up with those two―especially #C236196003Rin#CDEF,
who showed me respect―was fun.

…actually, #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF were the only
ones who pampered me!
…o-oh, is that so…?

…damn.
I may be feeling a bit of sympathy for #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…

Well, I DID betray my first Master.
I deserve what I got.

…hey.
Can I ask you something?

#C236196003Lancer#CDEF's voice was composed and serious,
with none of her trademark high-and-mighty attitude.
…her historical self may have been rational like this.
I can't… but I don't know precisely what to say.

…hmmm. Sounds good.
I wish you would've told me that last
time we fought.
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF…?

Forget it.
C'mon, break time is over.
Let's get a move on.
―――The air grows tense.

I can―――only enter―――
Beyond he―――rest is up to―――

Master, from this point―――
you, alone―――

Oh? I suddenly can't see well…
Actually… I'm, like… getting sleepy…
Oh… up ahead is my…

I heard #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's voice so clearly before,
but now it's going in and out.

Darling, be careful―――
I await your return―――

#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated

I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.

What's wrong, Praetor?

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

A shock suddenly runs through the palm of my hand.
I notice the cube #C236196003Rin#CDEF gave me is spinning extremely fast…

―――Hm?
This high-pitched chorus sounds familiar…
D-don't tell me…!

It can't be―― What's going on!?
It's grating noise no matter how you cut it,
but it's got rhythm like a song…!

This voice of death could split an umbilical
cord…! You've gone mad, #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF! These
shrieks akin to thunder belong to―――!

Hee―――Hee hee hee, ahahahahaha!
So, a question for you, #[piggy][squirrely]#!
You're in a fix, aren't you!?
Yes, I'm very much in a fix.
I don't really need any help.

Yes, I knew it! Even though you actually feel so
helpless that you want to cry, you're desperate
to look tough―you're in a fix! Fantastic!
Now, another question.
Yes, I very much long for one.

R-right! You understand, good! You said it in
an ordinary and dull way, but I appreciate
hearing honesty now and again.

You get 100 points―――
No, I'll even give you 120 points!

You feel hopeless enough to complain…
You've been drenched from the rain,
#[piggy][squirrely]#… and you're shivering… Okay!鷙

―――Ah!? N-no, I mustn't. I started
daydreaming for a second there.
You really are one sly Master, aren't you?

Now, final question.
If you get this wrong, I won't help you.
So FOCUS on your answer.

The beautiful and talented super idol,
imprisoned in jet black darkness for her beauty:
the #C236196003Lancer#CDEF with the most reappearances!

Just who in the world could this unrivaled diva,
"#C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF," be!?
I think―

"#C000246204Who could this peerless diva,
this 'Crimson Lancer,' be#CDEF?"

…is how she was supposed to phrase that.
I say―
Still as dis―ing as ever, huh, Lancer?

H-hm? Did I hear you whisper
"disappointing" or something?

No, that can't be.
#C236196003Rin#CDEF told me our friendship would flourish
after you and I fight alongside each other.

O-okay, let me prep one more time…
Yes, very well, #[piggy][squirrely]#!
I'll give you the encore your soul desires!

Erk… I-I start feeling bad when you beg me like
that… I mean, it was my fault… Actually,
I don't have a single good bone in my body…

B-but, I'm remorseful about it, honest!
I know you obviously won't forgive me,
but I want to be of some help to you!

So don't be so scared of meeee…!
I'll sing my heart out! I won't
draw so much blood anymore!

The Spiritrons produced within the box
suddenly break the seal, and a solid entity appears.

―――I ask of you. Are you my manager?
Just kidding! I really wanted to say that line!

Sorry to keep you waiting, my cattle!
The Blood Countess #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF heeds you
in your dire moment and now arrives!

I! Have! Arrived! Applaud now!
Don't hold back because you've
practically got an Arena seat.

Right after, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF looks at me in triumph,
her face screaming: "How was THAT?!"
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF made a woeful mistake.

Alright, then our contract is formed!
I'm sure #C236196003Rin#CDEF told you this,
but I'll state it clearly myself:

I'm your escort, your special buddy, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.
Now roughly twenty percent of your
soul belongs to me!

You're spewing nonsense, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…!
Praetor is 100% MINE! I wouldn't let you
borrow #[him][her]# for even a day!

Non-consensual contracts don't count.
#[This guy][She's]# contracted with me, anyway.
The rule is, you can't have two contracts.

Ah, well… Depending on the circumstances,
it may be possible, but that's something else.
The hell are you planning?

It looks like you're not a Berserker anymore…
Have you still lost your mind? Maybe you
never had one to begin with?

Who the HELL is going to give you twenty
percent!? Take seaweed's soul and be happy,
horn-girl! You can do as you like with THAT.

Gosh, has this ruined the mood!
You're just a pest! I don't like this!
What goes on in your head these days!?

I said I was fine with a trial contract, but
this will not do. Not in the slightest. WE'RE
the one's who should be receiving souls.

Anyway, have you gone mad?
Are you still a Berserker?
By what reasoning do you support #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF?

We fought and beat #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF three times.
She was sealed away.

Look, I made a deal. A deal, is all.
I was told I had a chance to help you all out,
so I hopped on board.

You need a Servant, don't you?
Then I'll fight for you, even if it's just
for a short while.

I had nothing else to do, anyway.
I wanted to go wild one more time.

I know one needs to make sacrifices sometimes,
but #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF isn't the kind of Servant
you can let out like nothing.

She talked about a deal.
I guess the condition was that she would
be unsealed if she cooperated.

So long as it's in her nature to seek blood,
letting her loose will bring about new victims―――

You've got the wrong idea. The seal has nothing
to do with anything. Once I'm done helping you,
I'm getting sealed away again immediately.

So what "deal" was made?
I wonder what #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is getting in return for helping us…

You don't need to understand, okay?
Now, there's no time for dawdling.
Lead the way, #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

You're going to defeat #C236196003BB#CDEF, right?
If you can't put down a lowly Servant like me,
you won't win against her.

G-grr… It breaks my heart to do this,
but I have no choice.
I place my #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND in your hands.

But lay one finger on #[him][her]#, and things
will get nasty later! And I'll be taking it
out on Praetor!

…you've got a point. Sure, if we can't rein
in an unruly Servant like this, then beating #C236196003BB#CDEF
is a pipe dream.

I'm worried about her personality-wise, but
she's certified tough. Master, there will be
headaches, but please work with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.

Grr… Now I have to show someone other than
Darling my secrets before marriage…
My marriage prospects are looking bleak…

Gah! I'll just use anyone who gets in the way of
my love, even a mother-in-law! And to be
honest, she seems more useful than a doll!

Yo, horn-girl. You've got some guts,
so I'll make an exception and allow you
to guard my Darling. Toil for #RUBS   the true wife's#RUBEmy#REND benefit.

OK, got it. This is like falling in love
while on a business trip. Don't some people
marry again while away somewhere?

Hee hee. Don't forget this business trip takes
place inside my body鷙 Make any threatening
moves, and I'll squash you like a bug☆

…now this I don't believe.
Are you truly #C236196003Lancer#CDEF, cur? For there isn't a
single contradiction in your logic.

Although I can't approve of anyone other than
this mongrel peeking at the king's true form―
this is an emergency. It will have to do.

Deep down, I can't trust her,
but her raw strength can be relied on.

…for now, I'll thank her for helping
and cautiously see how things pan out…

Phew, let's take a little break. These enemies
are annoying and the scenery is monotonous.
This is no fun at all.

I'm more tired than I thought I would be.
I never did like manual labor, though.

I can't believe we have to explore a place
like THIS. What a disaster for us, #[piggy][squirrely]#.

So sorry we inconvenience you, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
How about you care a little more and keep
walking, you lout.

Compared to how my considerate Praetor walks,
you stomp about without a care! You have
no grace, and I can't stand it!

The hell were you expecting? This place is
one form a mind can take. Obviously, it's
going to be complex.

I don't see any self-control in you, either.
You call yourself an idol, so learn how to
walk with a little more grace!

I'm the one who should call this a disaster.
Your half-ass model walk SUPER irritates me!
You think this is a runway!?

The way Darling walks is considerate
and gentle, and I can clearly sense the
#ROFS0001#RUBSadolescent#RUBEexcited#REND nervousness and anticipation…

Are you dying, knave? What crass and rude
manners you have? …not the kind of grace one
of the ruling class should always have.

I've never seen such a barbaric way of walking.
You're a degenerate dragon oaf descended
upon a verdant garden!

Hmph. Be thankful I can't skewer you with my
lance. I'm actually refraining from using my
lance as a walking stick to rest on.
She may be speaking rudely, but it's true that #C236196003Lancer#CDEF is tired.

Since our contract is just a temporary one,
I can't completely read into her status.
Still, she might not be faring so well.

…I increasingly find myself unable to read into
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF's motives.

She doesn't like manual labor,
so why take on hard work such as this?

Personal feelings.
Also… well, #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF asked me to.

Thinking back, the other people
who worked with her were #C236196003BB#CDEF, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF, and #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

Why do you want to leave the #C000246204Far Side of
the Moon#CDEF?

Now that #C236196003BB#CDEF has become the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF,
the outside world is already done for.

The old school building is the best and
only safe area there is.

Despite that, why are you trying to get out?
Not just you, but #C236196003Rin#CDEF, #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF, too.

Since she's being open with me,
I can't answer halfheartedly.

Saying "for humanity's sake" would sound nice.
But I think that's not quite right.
Long story short, it's for my own sake.

Although―――Simply put, it just feels like being here is wrong.
If there's an "outside," then I want to head there is all.

I hate prisons, too. Now that you tell me that
you don't like being trapped―I'll take this a
bit more seriously. I'll be your lance.

Beyond here is where the "primordial,"
bereft of all flesh and ornament, is.

The place where "#C236196003#SVT#CDEF" was birthed within this universe,
and the place where "#C236196003#SVT#CDEF" will ultimately end up.
That is to say, "zero."
―――an yo―――ar me―――Praetor―――

Looks like beyond here is an
unconscious region―――
I can't―――see any further―――

This is as far as I can see.
Beyond here is a man who lived as a savage,
before he became aware of death.

The closer I get to this place,
the less the "present" #C236196003#SVT#CDEF is able to interfere, I guess.

Mhm―――can't say much.
I believe you'll be victorious―――

It's unfortunate that I can't personally take
care of this, which is why it's up to you―――
Don't hold back, get it done―――!

I have no words for my divinity laid bare.
Thoroughly dispatch of him.

H-hold, Praetor.
That area is structurally tender,
so don't run or walk back and forth―――

It's taking our all to fight your instincts
here. If we tip-toe around for you,
we'll be sitting ducks.

As your rival, let me give you some advice:
cut down on meat as much as you can.
Go eat sweets, instead―sweets.

Changing fashions are but temporary
distractions; in the end, being slender always
wins out. Right, #[piggy][squirrely]#?

T-that's got NOTHING to do with THIS!
And don't put your finger on Praetor's chin!
Stop nuzzling uggling up on #[him][her]#!

Don't make light of my favored delicacies.
I'll have myself some dragon steak if need be!

I understand how you feel―you want to take
a good, long look around―but that area is
only the beginning.

I'd prefer you bask in a CLOSE look at my
tempered curves if you're going to look around―
from my sides up to my armpit鷙

That's what makes foxes lesser creatures.
You mask your lines with your fur, then grade
yourself as pure and cute.

On that note, MY lines are perfect.
My brilliant, smooth skin is captivating
and has no excess.

Yes! It's as if my skin is covered in
sexy scales!

Hey! Don't capitalize on Darling's confusion to
get all touchy! Idols aren't allowed to be
in relationships, so stick to that rule!

M-my treasured collection is over there,
it's an important place! Don't touch anything!!

What's gotten you into such a fluster, Saber?
Hmm～ What embarrassing things can we find here…?

Stop. That's an unrelated area…!
Head straight inside without any detours.

Must be something incriminating. Sounds like perfect
revenge for all the pervy stuff you did earlier鷙

…hear that? There's got to be something amazing
in there to fluster that pink fox like that…!

Oh? Even a dungeon made of my spiritrons
is full of treasure.

It might be a bit late, but my Golden Rule is rather
exceptional. Take it. Heh, I'm sure it'll be fantastic.
So this is #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's #RUBS  inner space#RUBECyber Frame#REND―――

The ambiance is different, but the basic composition
isn't so different from #C236196003Sakura#CDEF's #ROFS-001#RUBSinner space#RUBEdigital form#REND.

This is the first time that I've invited you in,
so be sure to start off shy
and reserved―take it all in!

Naturally, this IS my body.
Being dormant, I can't move a single finger.
But my mind is free.

#C236196003Rin#CDEF also asked me to navigate you. It's a little
awkward guiding you around my interior,
but I'll show you the way.
Now that #SVT[she][he][she][he]# mentions it, I look behind me.

There's no one there.
#C236196003Saber#CDEF of course won't be here,
but I don't see the familiar #C236196003Rin#CDEF said she would send with me…!

I can't fight all on my own.
If the immune programs find me,
they'll mercilessly disassemble me…!

It's okay, wait, think about this.
T-t-t-this is no time to be panicking!

This is #C236196003Rin#CDEF being clumsy. Decompressing
that familiar must be taking some time.
A doll will appear soon enough.

For now, press on carefully, a little bit at a
time. Slowly, gently. I hate it when I get
hurt or when the mood isn't there!

…jeez, look at your sorry self…
